q.en: "The factory increased its ___ of cars by 20% this year."
q.bn: "The factory increased its ___ of cars by 20% this year."

why.en: "Production" is the noun form, needed here after "its".

q.en: "Hundreds of workers were made ___ after the factory closed."
q.bn: "Hundreds of workers were made ___ after the factory closed."

why.en: "Made redundant" means losing a job because it's no longer needed.
why.bn: "Made redundant" মানে চাকরি হারানো কারণ সেটা আর প্রয়োজন নেই।

q.en: Which stage of the business cycle follows a recession?
q.bn: Business cycle-এ recession-এর পরে কোন stage আসে?

why.en: After a recession, the economy enters "recovery" before eventually reaching another boom.
why.bn: Recession-এর পরে economy "recovery"-তে ঢোকে, তারপর আরেকটা boom-এ পৌঁছায়।

q.en: Which pair contrasts manual/industrial labour with office/professional work?
q.bn: কোন pair manual/industrial labour আর office/professional work-এর মধ্যে contrast দেখায়?

why.en: "Blue-collar" refers to manual/industrial jobs; "white-collar" refers to office/professional jobs.
why.bn: "Blue-collar" মানে manual/industrial job; "white-collar" মানে office/professional job।

why.en: "Attract foreign investment" is the standard collocation for drawing in money from overseas companies or governments.
why.bn: "Attract foreign investment" standard collocation, বিদেশি company বা government-এর টাকা আনার জন্য।
